extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures extracted: Figure 1a and Figure 2a. Figure 2b was skipped because it is an Arrhenius plot. Figures 1b, 3, 4, 5, and 6 are characterization/mechanism figures and were skipped. The green Ru/Ca2N:e− series in Figure 2a was not extracted because Table 1 cites it to ref 13 rather than this work; it appears to be a comparison series. Time-on-stream data in Figure 1a were reduced to first and last plotted points per instruction. Figure values are approximate readings from the plotted markers.
